releases.body:
Name the drawing instead of calling it a figure

The table is the first thing a reader sees about this package, and "a figure" names nothing while "a bar per step" does not say it is a chart. Release oc-tps-meter 0.4.3.


Record: docs/oc-tps-meter.md

Show a step too short to measure

A two-word reply has no speed worth drawing — the window is the timer's resolution — so its slot was left empty and read as a session that did nothing. It now wears the same 2 px a cut bar wears, at the baseline.


Record: docs/oc-tps-meter.md

Close the panel without throwing its tab away

The app leaves the side region open on its new-tab page once its last tab goes, so a second click no longer
closed what the first opened. Hiding the pane collapses the region and keeps the tab, which is what closing
it for room asks for. Carries the note on which tok/s each number answers.


Record: docs/oc-tps-meter.md
